sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of proceeds We are not guaranteed to receive any particular amount of proceeds from this offering. The amount of net proceeds we receive will depend upon the number of shares of our common stock sold and the prices at which they are sold, after deducting sales commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering, together with our existing cash, to fund our growth strategies, including potential acquisitions, for working capital to support the expected growing sales within our core OSS segment and for other general corporate purposes. We may use a portion of the net proceeds to fund the cash consideration payable in connection with a potential acquisition of a complementary business.
